title: Repair Brain Damage: Real-Numbered Error Correction Code for Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2602.00076v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study neural networks (NNs) operating under hardware-induced memory faults and computational errors, which can degrade reliability in safety-critical applications. To address this challenge, we propose a novel real-valued error correction coding (ECC) framework capable of detecting and correcting both types of errors. Our approach imposes structured real-valued linear constraints on network weights, enabling efficient error detection and recovery without increasing the number of parameters or compromising classification performance. The proposed method leverages linear programming and sparse recovery techniques to achieve low-complexity error correction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first real-number-based ECC scheme that simultaneously addresses memory and computational errors in neural networks.

translated_title: 修复大脑损伤：面向神经网络的实数纠错码
translated_abstract: 我们研究在硬件引起的内存故障和计算错误下运行的神经网络（NN），这些错误会降低安全关键应用的可靠性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的实值纠错编码（ECC）框架，能够检测并纠正这两类错误。我们的方法对网络权重施加结构化的实值线性约束，能够在不增加参数数量或不损害分类性能的前提下实现高效的错误检测与恢复。所提出的方法利用线性规划和稀疏恢复技术来实现低复杂度的纠错。据我们所知，这是首个能够同时处理神经网络中内存错误和计算错误的基于实数的纠错编码方案。
tldr: 提出首个基于实数的神经网络纠错编码框架，通过对权重施加结构化线性约束，在不增加参数、不损害分类性能的情况下同时检测并纠正硬件引发的内存错误与计算错误。
en_tdlr: The first real-number-based error correction coding framework for neural networks, which uses structured linear constraints on weights to simultaneously detect and correct both memory faults and computational errors without increasing parameters or degrading classification performance.
